---
title: "`r params$title`"
author: "`r params$authors`"
date: "Codebook Generated `r Sys.Date()`"
output: 
  html_document:
    self_contained: true
    keep_md: false
    toc: true
    toc_depth: 5
    css: styles.css
    includes:
      before_body: 
        - content-wrapper-start.html
        - logo.html
      after_body: 
        - content-wrapper-end.html
knitr:
  opts_chunk:
    message: false
    warning: false
params:
  title: "Default Title"
  authors: "Default Author"
  # Display codechunk options (default is true for all)
  titlePage: true
  nameOfStudy: true
  # This is the only one given a non matching name since its too close to other yaml arg
  displayAuthors: true
  desiredGraphic: true
  funding: true
  abstract: true
  effectiveSummary: true
  displayMeta: true
  histogram: true
  missingnessPage: true
  descriptives: true
  barPlot: true
  frequencyTableDisplay: true
  typeOfData: true
  deliveryType: true
  screenshot: true
  skipLogic: true
---

```{r Highest-Level-Template-Chunk, include = FALSE}

library(knitr)
out <- knit_expand("Codebook.Rmd")

```

<a href="#" id="backToTopBtn" title="Go to top">↑</a>


`r knit(text=out)`
